senses.gloss: m. pl. (corrupt. of קוּנְטִרְיוֹנִ׳, centuriones) centurions, commanders of centuries.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 317:5">Sifré Deut. 317</cite> (play on <he>ב̇נ̇י בש̇ן̇</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:14">Deut. XXXII, 14</cite>) <he>אלו ק׳ שמכישין מב̇ין̇ ש̇נ̇יהם</he> (not <he>שמכינין</he>) that means the (Roman) centurions that cause striking from between their teeth (command attacks on unarmed people); Yalk. ib. 944 <he>קוטרינין שמכישין וכ׳</he>.
